declarations.name: AuiCommandPalette

inputs.name: commands
inputs.description: Commands: { id, label, keywords?, group?, description?, shortcut?, icon?, children?, disabled?, run? }.

inputs.name: providers
inputs.description: Async searches ({ id, label, search(query, { signal }), minQueryLength? }), listed after the commands.

inputs.name: recent
inputs.description: Command ids shown in the Recent section while the query is empty.

inputs.name: recentLimit
inputs.description: Most recent commands remembered (0 hides the section).

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Search, loading, back, and submenu icons.

inputs.name: shortcut
inputs.description: Hotkey that opens and closes the palette (matchesHotkey syntax; Mod is Cmd on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere); null for none.

inputs.name: debounce
inputs.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and provider searches (0 to 2000).

inputs.name: overscan
inputs.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the visible area.

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: A command was chosen: { id, command, path, query, providerId }; preventDefault() skips command.run. The palette closes first.

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open(options?: { page?: string; query?: string; } | undefined): void | undefined
methods.description: Open, optionally on a command's nested page and with a query.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Replace the search text and search.

accessibility.pattern: Modal dialog (native <dialog>, inert background) containing a WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox whose listbox is always shown: focus stays in the search field and aria-activedescendant points at the active option. Section headers are presentational rows; the active option always stays rendered while the list is virtualized.

limitations: Rows have one height per density; long labels are truncated with an ellipsis.
Providers are searched at the top level only, not on nested pages.
The default shortcut Ctrl+K overrides the browser's search shortcut while the page has focus; set shortcut to another hotkey or null.
